requirements.title: Computed GO TO syntax has a label list and scalar integer selector
requirements.definition: A computed-goto-stmt is GO TO followed by a parenthesized label-list, an optional comma, and a scalar integer expression.

pending.computed-go-to-with-comma: PENDING positive-control computed GO TO with the optional comma present and all labels satisfying C1175.
pending.computed-go-to-without-comma: PENDING positive-control computed GO TO with the optional comma omitted and all labels satisfying C1175.
pending.label-list-form: PENDING source-control syntax plan with at least two valid labels so p1's i-th-label effect is observable.
pending.scalar-integer-selector: PENDING source diagnostic/control pair for non-scalar or non-integer selector forms, attributed to R1160 only after inherited expression predicates are reviewed.

requirements.oracle: Syntax admission only; target validity and selected transfer are owned by C1175 and p1.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Future fixtures must isolate the cited source unit, use a conforming positive control when a diagnostic is expected, and observe control transfer by which statement executes next rather than by assumed branch implementation, compiler wording, process status, or agreement with another processor.
requirements.dependencies: 6.4 labels registered;10.1.9 expression characteristics registered;11.2.1 branch concepts and C1175 in this packet.

requirements.title: Each computed GO TO label designates a branch target in the same inclusive scope
requirements.definition: Each label in the label-list of a computed GO TO statement shall be the statement label of a branch target statement that appears in the same inclusive scope as the computed-goto-stmt.

pending.computed-go-to-valid-labels-control: PENDING positive-control computed GO TO whose every label is a branch target in the same inclusive scope.
pending.computed-go-to-nonbranch-target-label-re: PENDING diagnostic/control pair where exactly one list entry labels a non-branch-target statement kind; repair changes only that target statement kind while preserving label-list position.
pending.computed-go-to-out-of-scope-label-reject: PENDING diagnostic/control pair where exactly one list entry identifies an otherwise valid branch target outside the computed GO TO statement's inclusive scope; repair moves only that target into the same inclusive scope.

requirements.oracle: Each negative differs in one property of one label-list entry and is attributed solely to C1175, not to selector expression or p1 branch choice.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Future fixtures must isolate the cited source unit, use a conforming positive control when a diagnostic is expected, and observe control transfer by which statement executes next rather than by assumed branch implementation, compiler wording, process status, or agreement with another processor.
requirements.dependencies: 11.2.1 branch-target statement kinds;6.4 labels;scope and construct owners for individual target kinds.

requirements.title: Executing computed GO TO selects an in-range label or continues for out-of-range values
requirements.definition: Execution of a computed GO TO evaluates the scalar integer expression. If its value is i with 1 <= i <= n, where n is the number of labels in the label-list, a branch occurs to the branch target statement identified by the i-th label. If i is less than 1 or greater than n, execution continues as though a CONTINUE statement were executed.

pending.selector-expression-evaluated: PENDING runtime plan with an independently set scalar integer variable or expression and sentinels proving selection uses its value.
pending.first-label-selected: PENDING runtime plan choosing i=1 and observing only the first label's target sentinel before common continuation.
pending.middle-or-last-label-selected: PENDING runtime plan choosing another in-range value and observing the corresponding i-th label target, not merely any listed target.
pending.low-out-of-range-continues: PENDING runtime plan choosing i<1 and observing fallthrough continuation as though CONTINUE executed, with no listed-target sentinel executed.
pending.high-out-of-range-continues: PENDING runtime plan choosing i>n and observing the same continuation behavior without assuming a diagnostic or host status.

requirements.oracle: Use distinct sentinels for every label target and for fallthrough. The out-of-range behavior is a normal execution effect, not an error or processor latitude.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Branching effects must be observed with distinguishable sentinels for the statement reached next; tests must not inspect implementation jump mechanics or attribute a branch-target violation to more than one rule.
